name: a new life.
source:
A classic love story: Meet, marry, grow old.
But when your loved one hurts you, what do you do?
Is it better to love and be hurt, than never love at all?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297160/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个经典的爱情故事：相遇、结婚、变老。
但当你所爱的人伤害你时，你会怎么做？
爱过却被伤害，是不是比从不爱更好？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1297160/]Steam[/url]]
